graphify._comment: Serves graphify-out/graph.json over stdio. Uses the uv-tool-installed graphifyy venv (bare python3 can't import graphify/mcp); 'graphify-mcp' resolves to the same interpreter. Requires `uv tool install graphifyy --with mcp --with openai --with tree-sitter-language-pack` + one `graphify update .` to seed graphify-out/.

mlflow._comment: Disabled here: mlflow must not be a godot-mcp dependency (conflicts with the FastMCP 4.x pin). Eval->MLflow logging and the mlflow MCP server are owned by godot-agents; wire it there.

godot-agents.description: The agent orchestrator that consumes this server's MCP tool surface. godot-agents pins godot-mcp's exact tool names, param keys, toolset categories, and response envelope. Consult it as a downstream consumer when a tool/param/envelope change might break callers, or when checking how a tool is actually invoked in practice.
